Category: Korean technical directed-graph infographic for a research article.
Scene: Map one explicitly hypothetical equipment inspection decision to OpenCrab's nine semantic Spaces.
Camera: straight-on orthographic view, zero perspective distortion.
Composition: 16:9 landscape, clean four-row directed acyclic graph with large cards and short labels. Top title exact text ‘가상 사례: 설비 점검 주기 30일 → 14일’. Row 1: ‘Policy — 책임자 승인 필요’ above two cards ‘Subject — 현장팀 · 정비 책임자’ and ‘Resource — 매뉴얼 · 점검표 · 센서 데이터 · API’; draw Policy → Subject and Policy → Resource. Row 2: draw Resource → ‘Evidence — 진동 측정값 · 고장 로그’. Row 3: Evidence forks into ‘Concept — 베어링 마모 · 진동 증가’ and ‘Claim — 진동 증가가 고장 위험을 높인다’; draw Evidence → Concept and Evidence → Claim. Place ‘Community — 반복 고장 패턴 (선택)’ left of Concept and draw Community → Concept. Row 4: ‘Lever — 점검 주기 · 교체 임계값’ and Concept both point to ‘Outcome — 비가동 시간 · 고장 위험 · 정비 비용’; draw Lever → Outcome and Concept → Outcome. These seven arrows are the only arrows. Use clear arrowheads and spacious non-crossing routes.

prompt:
Category: Korean technical lifecycle infographic for a research article.
Scene: Show OpenCrab's Pack and MCP lifecycle plus four incomplete boundaries in a clear compact layout.
Camera: straight-on orthographic view, zero perspective distortion.
Composition: 16:9 landscape, two-row 4+4 pipeline with large cards. Row 1 left-to-right: ‘Mission’ → ‘수집 · 파싱’ → ‘Evidence 색인’ → ‘9-Space 그래프’. A single clear downward turn arrow connects row 1 card 4 to row 2 card 1. Row 2 left-to-right: ‘문법 · 품질 검사’ → ‘Pack v1’ → ‘MCP’ → ‘Agent’. Place a solid small badge ‘필수 게이트’ above ‘문법 · 품질 검사’ and another above ‘Pack v1’. Under Pack, one large box exact text ‘manifest · nodes/edges · evidence index · quality report · Neo4j snapshot’. Under MCP, one large box exact text ‘온톨로지·검색 · Workflow·Approval · Identity·Promotion · Schema Pack·Billing·CrabHarness’. Bottom row contains four independent amber caution chips with exact text ‘Approval 선택적’, ‘Promotion 선택적’, ‘Pack 연합 계약 없음’, ‘QueryResult ≠ AnswerBundle’. Bottom conclusion exact text ‘지식 유통은 보이지만 운영 강제와 Pack 연합은 아직 미완성’. Use only the pipeline arrows; caution chips have zero connectors.
